(async()=>{const CKm=await import('/js/flight/cockpit.js'), THREE=await import('three'); const CK=CKm.CK; CK.group.updateMatrixWorld(true); const inv=CK.group.matrixWorld.clone().invert(); const out=[]; CK.model.traverse(o=>{ if(!o.isMesh) return; const b=new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(o); b.applyMatrix4(inv); const c=b.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()), s=b.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()); if (s.x<0.25 && s.y<0.25 && s.z<0.25 && c.y<-0.6 && c.x<-0.3 && c.x>-0.8) out.push([o.name, o.geometry.attributes.position.count, c.toArray().map(v=>+v.toFixed(3)), s.toArray().map(v=>+v.toFixed(3))]); }); return JSON.stringify(out)})()
